description: This file defines the InProcessTestClusterBuilder class used for configuring and building in-process Orleans test clusters, including methods for setting up silos, clients, ports, and cluster IDs.

classes.name: InProcessTestClusterBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating in-process Orleans test clusters.

classes.name: ConfigureStaticClusterDeploymentOptions
classes.description: A nested class implementing IHostConfigurator to configure static cluster deployment options.

methods.name: InProcessTestClusterBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with default or specified number of silos.

methods.description: Adds a delegate for configuring silo and client hosts.
